name: Shizuku to Asobo☆
source:
Raul is a magician whose job is to protect humans from ferocious monsters called demon beasts. His familiar is the half-human, half-demon cat-eared Shizuku.

One day, after some time has passed since the two began to love each other,  they get a chance to be alone with a box of dubious magic items.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ125128.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
劳尔是一位魔法师，他的工作是保护人类免受被称为魔兽的凶猛怪物的侵害。他的使魔是半人半妖的猫耳雫。

有一天，自从两人开始相爱一段时间后，他们有机会单独相处一盒可疑的魔法物品。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ125128.html]DLsite[/url]]
